angularDiameterSource: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.922 ± 0.036 mas (quadratic limb-darkening fit) measured with IOTA/IONIC by Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561; at the Hipparcos distance this is the record’s radius.
distanceSource: Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 88.83 ± 0.54 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD
radiusSource: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.922 ± 0.036 mas (quadratic limb-darkening fit) measured with IOTA/IONIC by Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561; at the Hipparcos distance this is the record’s radius. Adopted 17,617,284 km, 25.3231 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 4295 ± 26 K from Lacour et al. 2008 (A&A 485, 561; https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361:200809611), abstract: the IOTA/IONIC Rosseland diameter 21.05 ± 0.21 mas with the bolometric flux.
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.66 +/- 0.05 measured by Ramirez & Allende Prieto 2011 (ApJ 743, 135; https://arxiv.org/abs/1109.4425), abstract

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
